homogeneousOnlyRationale: Architect v2.1 models exactly one target cluster architecture. OCP 4.22 supports ARM compute on x86 bare-metal control planes, but that is outside the product boundary (plan O8). This matrix must not be read as permitting mixed-arch clusters.

architectureKinds.localExportBinary: arch of openshift-install / oc / oc-mirror the operator downloads

fips.quote: When running Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) or Red Hat Enterprise Linux CoreOS (RHCOS) booted in FIPS mode, OpenShift Container Platform core components use the RHEL cryptographic libraries that have been submitted to NIST for FIPS 140-2/140-3 Validation on only the x86_64, ppc64le, and s390x architectures.
fips.productDefect: NONE. Corrected in Tranche 1.5 final review. An earlier revision claimed frontend/src/steps/ReviewStep.jsx offering 'Linux ARM64 (RHEL 9 FIPS)' was a defect; that conflated the cluster-node FIPS statement with the export/download tool-binary axis. Red Hat publishes openshift-install-rhel9-arm64.tar.gz for 4.20.40, 4.21.35 and 4.22.16 (verified against each release's own sha256sum.txt; the arm64 artifact was downloaded, checksum-verified, and confirmed to be an ELF aarch64 executable). The UI option is correct and the removal was reverted.

currentProductClaimsNote: These originate from a 4.20-era scan. They may be correct, but they were NOT confirmed against 4.22 evidence in this tranche. Closing them from the per-platform 4.22 books (plan source S8) is Tranche 2 work and is exactly what DOC-156 exists to force.
installMethodDependence: Agent-based installer architecture support depends on whether the release image is multi-payload or single-arch, a property of the install method rather than the platform. A platform-keyed table cannot express this; this is the structural justification for D3 independent of which cells are true.

heterogeneousCompute.capability: OCP 4.22 supports adding ARM nodes to bare metal clusters with x86 control planes using PXE or virtual media, by creating a BareMetalHost object with the aarch64 architecture
heterogeneousCompute.productBoundary: OUT OF SCOPE for v2.1. Host Inventory is not redesigned. Architect models one target cluster architecture.
heterogeneousCompute.obligation: Tranche 2 must mark the arch data homogeneousOnly and state the limitation in bare-metal Field Guide/help text, because silence now reads as 'not possible', which is wrong.
